info.name: Select Star Metadata bi data-metrics API

params.name: data_source
params.description: Search for activities given a data source name

params.name: end_date
params.description: The end date of the date filter. The end date has to be set to equal or later than start date. The maximum date range limit user can set is equal to 90 days. Format: YYYY-MM-DD

params.name: message
params.description: Search for activities given a description

params.name: order
params.description: Specify the ordering for the results. A comma separated list for ordering by multiple fields and a preceding `-` indicates reverse order.

params.name: page
params.description: A page number within the paginated result set.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Number of results to return per page.

params.name: search_all
params.description: Search for activities given a user, activity type or target name

params.name: start_date
params.description: The start date of the date filter. The start date has to be set to before or equal than end date. The maximum date range limit user can set is equal to 90 days. Format: YYYY-MM-DD

params.name: target
params.description: Search for activities given a target name

params.name: target_full_name
params.description: Search for schema changes given a target full name

params.name: type
params.description: Search for activities given an activity type

params.name: types
params.description: Specify the type of activity to filter for the results.

params.name: user
params.description: Search by 'user' using first name, last name, or email
